messages.subject: Sorting percentages with DataTables
parts:
I have a DataTable where I want to display a column as a percentage.  I tried using the "percent" function in the scales package to transform the column into a percentage.  When I do this, it transforms the variable from numeric to character which screws up sorting with the DataTable. For example, the DataTable will think 19% < 2% because it is sorting the column as a character and1 is less than 2. Does anyone know a workaround to display the percentage, but leaves the class as numeric?

Thanks,
Josh
